verdict.rationale: Name.com's Core API has a documented TLD price list endpoint. It returns an alphabetical list of all supported TLDs with pricing for each order type, which covers registration, renewal and transfer (name-com-docs-18). Three pricing tiers are offered (account-level, original, retail), and the check-availability endpoint returns per-domain pricing (name-com-docs-13, name-com-docs-3), so tooling can compare and budget. Missing for 10: no explicit field-level confirmation that renewal and transfer prices are broken out separately, no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
